about: F1: this vector checks formula arithmetic and Bell-squared counts for n=3..7, using binary64 logarithms. It does not itself enumerate partition pairs.

Existing law samples and laws-papers tests already supply finite partition checks for the declared proof chain; their exact scope is recorded below. General optimality and browser/WASM independent verification are not established by this vector.

coverage.why: finite arithmetic checks; not a general proof

finiteChecks.lem-merge: all positive block sizes p+q<=6; all coarsenings on n=4
finiteChecks.lem-meet: 225 ordered pairs on n=4, weighted restricted-pair decomposition and bound
finiteChecks.lem-join: all ordered trivial-meet pairs on n=3,4,5: 15,119,1343; discrete-join pairs: 8,56,552
finiteChecks.thm-extremal: existing test checks c_n formula values at n=1,2,4,16; this does not check all extremizers

existingEvidence.remaining: No n=6,7 exhaustive extrema enumeration or independent browser/WASM execution is supplied by these referenced finite tests. The declared general proof still requires verification of its unrestricted derivations and equality classification.
